ABEL local Canon CR3 decoder

libraw-wasm-nothread 1.6.0-nothread.1, ISC license (LICENSE).
Copyright ybouane and contributors; copyright 2026 Oscar Gallego Ruiz.
Unmodified npm distribution libraw.js and libraw.wasm, pinned by package-lock.json
and integrity.json. Reproduce the vendor copy with npm ci && npm run vendor:raw.
Source and build configuration:
https://github.com/garbarok/libraw-wasm-nothread
https://www.npmjs.com/package/libraw-wasm-nothread/v/1.6.0-nothread.1
Upstream wrapper: https://github.com/ybouane/LibRaw-Wasm/tree/v1.6.0

LibRaw 0.22.1: distributed under CDDL 1.0 (LICENSE.CDDL and COPYRIGHT).
The unmodified library's complete corresponding source, including its embedded
third-party notices and build files, is available at:
https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw/tree/0.22.1
https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw/archive/refs/tags/0.22.1.tar.gz
No LibRaw source modifications by ABEL. The wrapper's compileLibraw.sh documents
the Emscripten configuration. ABEL's raw-worker.js is separate JavaScript.
Embedded BSD notices: LICENSE-LIBRAW-NOTICES.
